description: Returns a list of crash groups for an app, optionally filtered by date range. Does not support filtering by status — use list_issues with type=crash and issue_status if you need open/resolved/closed crashes only.

app_id.description: The public app ID (e.g. 5X3c4veRGV) from list_apps

limit.description: Max number of crashes to return. Defaults to 20.

name: get_crashes
